items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: I worked there with him and somebody else I worked with Dave. Oh, at the downtown, I worked at the downtown with Dave. And quite a few jobs, other outside jobs with Dave. I made the recordings with Dave.

ctx.x: Yeah, well we'll start thinking about it, you know, go back to the beginning and think some more and different things. Like the Lamplighter, wasn't that the name of the place you worked with?

Yeah, the horn you asked was the Lamplighter. It was on Bourbon and right across the street from where Pete Barney used to have, before he's had his club, I worked there with Dave, man, Williams, Fat Man Williams. Yeah, that's St. Anne and Bourbon. St. Anne and Bourbon. I worked there with him and somebody else I worked with Dave. Oh, at the downtown, I worked at the downtown with Dave. And quite a few jobs, other outside jobs with Dave. I made the recordings with Dave. I just can't think of everything.
Yeah, well that day at downtown, that's the one at Toulouse and Bourbon or? Toulouse and Bourbon.
